bullets.text: GTA VI is out now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. There's still no PC release date.
Critics are almost unanimous: it sits at 99 on Metacritic, with perfect scores from IGN and GameSpot.
First confirmed Easter eggs: an egg nest atop Vice City's tallest tower, a famous TV apartment on Washington Island, and Bigfoot in Gullet Marsh.
The Standard Edition costs $79.99 and the Ultimate $99.99. GTA Online isn't part of this launch.
